NSIS 3.13 and the NSIS LZMA compression module

OnlyWinget setup uses the unmodified NSIS 3.13 LZMA module. The applicable
NSIS terms, including the Common Public License 1.0 and its NSIS LZMA
linking exception, are in COPYING.txt. The accompanying source archive
nsis-3.13-src.tar.bz2 is the original upstream release and is available
from the distributor as part of this setup. The module source is under
Source/7zip in that archive.

Upstream source
https://sourceforge.net/projects/nsis/files/NSIS%203/3.13/nsis-3.13-src.tar.bz2/download
